theory Native_Backend_Acceptance
imports "CRefine_Semantic_Base.Semantic_Root"
begin

unbundle l4v_word_context

context fixes x :: nat assumes side_assumption: "x = 1" begin
lemma shared_fact: "x + 1 = 2" using side_assumption by simp
end

lemma accepted_consumer: "(x::nat) = 1 \<Longrightarrow> x + 1 = 2" by (rule shared_fact)

lemma recovered: "(x::nat) = 1 \<Longrightarrow> x + 1 = 2" by (rule shared_fact)

locale audit_locale = fixes y :: nat
context audit_locale begin
lemma scoped_fact: "y = y" by simp
end

end
